variables.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: The origin of the Supabase API the application queries, the project's API URL as the Supabase dashboard shows it.

variables.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: The Supabase project's anon key. It is public by design and reaches every browser, but it is kept in the parameter store because it is a signed token, which secret scanners and the repository's reply screen refuse to see in a tracked file.

variables.name: PUBLIC_PROJECT_ID
variables.description: The id of the project every query the application issues is scoped to; there is no fallback, so it must name a project that exists in the database.

variables.name: ORIGIN
variables.description: The public origin of the deployment as a browser sees it, scheme and host with no trailing slash; without it the server takes each request's origin from headers the client sets.

variables.name: ADDRESS_HEADER
variables.description: The request header in which the nearest trusted proxy sets the client address, usually x-forwarded-for behind a load balancer.

variables.name: XFF_DEPTH
variables.description: The number of trusted proxies in front of the server, counted from the right of the address header; set it to the number of proxies the deployment actually has.

variables.name: KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds the server keeps an idle connection open; set it above the load balancer's idle timeout so the load balancer, not the server, closes idle connections.

variables.name: HEADERS_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds the server waits for a request's headers; set it above KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT so a reused connection is never cut while its next request is arriving.

variables.name: SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds the server waits for requests in flight after a stop signal before it exits; set it below the container's stop timeout so the process exits by itself rather than being killed.

variables.name: PUBLIC_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: The minimum level the structured logger emits, one of debug, info, warn or error; unset falls back to warn.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_PROVIDER
variables.description: Where analytics events go, one of none, log or posthog; unset means none, and posthog without a key is refused at start.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_CONSENT_MODE
variables.description: Whether events wait for the voter's consent, gated (the default) or free; whether consent is needed is for the deployer to determine.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_VISIT_ID_MODE
variables.description: How a visit is identified across events, memory (the default) or none.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_POSTHOG_HOST
variables.description: The PostHog host events are forwarded to, an https origin; unset means the PostHog EU cloud.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: How often the server hands queued analytics events to the provider, in milliseconds, an integer from 500 to 600000; unset means 2000. An invalid value refuses start and names the variable. A long interval is for observing the shutdown flush and the full queue only.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_POSTHOG_KEY
variables.description: The PostHog project key events are forwarded with; it is a secret and is read only when ANALYTICS_PROVIDER is posthog.

variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_DIAGNOSTICS
variables.description: Set to true to switch on /api/diagnostics, which reports the resolved origin, client address and forwarding headers; set it only while a proxy setup is being checked, and false otherwise.

variables.name: PUBLIC_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_TYPE
variables.description: The identity provider bank authentication uses, signicat-ftn or idura-ftn. The module sets it from the root's identity_provider_type, so environment_values does not.

variables.name: PUBLIC_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: The client id of the application at the identity provider; identity-callback checks the same value, its IDENTITY_PROVIDER_CLIENT_ID secret, as the token's audience.

variables.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_JWKS_URI
variables.description: The URL of the identity provider's signing key set, the jwks_uri of its live openid-configuration, verbatim; identity-callback reads the same value.

variables.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ISSUER
variables.description: The issuer of the identity provider's tokens, the issuer of its live openid-configuration, verbatim; identity-callback reads the same value.

variables.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_DECRYPTION_JWKS
variables.description: The private key set, a JSON array, that decrypts the identity provider's encrypted ID tokens; a secret, and identity-callback reads the same value.

variables.name: IDENTITY_CALLBACK_SERVER_SECRET
variables.description: The secret the server sends to identity-callback, which refuses every request without it; a secret that must equal the function's IDENTITY_CALLBACK_SERVER_SECRET.

variables.name: PUBLIC_IDENTITY_PROVIDER_AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Signicat's authorization endpoint, from its openid-configuration, to which the browser is sent to sign in.

variables.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Signicat's token endpoint, from its openid-configuration, at which the server exchanges the authorization code.

variables.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: The client secret of the application at Signicat, with which the server exchanges the authorization code; a secret.

variables.name: IDURA_DOMAIN
variables.description: The domain of the Idura broker, such as example.idura.broker.

variables.name: IDURA_SIGNING_KEY_KID
variables.description: The key id, in IDURA_SIGNING_JWKS, of the key the server signs its Idura requests with.

variables.name: IDURA_SIGNING_JWKS
variables.description: The private key set, a JSON array, with which the server signs its requests to Idura and authenticates as the client; a secret.
